correctness.rationale: Exact exhaustive enumeration of all \(2^{18}\) arc subsets produces the 686-face complex and verifies all face deletions. A fully checked 326-pair acyclic matching leaves cells in dimensions 0,2,3,4 with counts 1,5,22,6. Exact signed integral Morse differential reductions all vanish. Five independent integral degree-two cocycles have all 25 rational pairwise cup products in the degree-four coboundary image; torsion-free integral \(H^4\) makes the cup products integrally zero. By Hurewicz and the low-degree Hilton–Milnor decomposition this kills all degree-3 and degree-4 attaching obstructions; the resulting integral wedge is proved, not inferred from homology alone. Separate mod-two simplicial ranks (17,91,164,54) corroborate the Betti calculation.

value.rationale: This is a natural cyclic graph constructed from the two smallest triangular layers joined by a perfect matching and is adjacent to recent polygonal-digraph multipath research. Its 18-arc complex has a genuine mixed-dimensional 5/22/6 homotopy type. Proving that the four-cell attachments vanish requires the entire cup-product calculation and is not a routine Euler-characteristic or homology computation. It provides a reproducible exact homotopy benchmark outside single-polygon and double-star families, without claiming a general prism theorem.
